take: Toronto announced that it placed forward Kirill Marchenko on injured reserve. In 14 games he has 6 goals and 8 assists, and TOR has controlled 56% of the 5-on-5 chances (expected goals, a measure of shot quality) with him on the ice, 14 points better than without him. In the one game since he went out, Easton Cowan has taken his spot beside Paul and Nylander, up to 19:08 a night from 15:13, and Jack Roslovic has moved onto the first power-play unit.
